scenes.narration: Sources checked October fifteenth. Here are three things to understand about Joule Work after SAP Connect.
First, Joule Work uses natural language for tasks across SAP and third-party data. SAP says customer rollout is beginning.
Second, SAP says its Knowledge Graph supplies business context for Joule. The announcement connects the interface to underlying business information.
Third, SAP lists Joule Work among managed experiences activated through SAP for Me. Confirm what this means for your organization’s access.
